case_name: Smt. Pushpa Soni vs Daulat Ram Soni
facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife seeks transfer of Civil Suit from Family Court, Korba to Family Court, Raigarh due to distance and lack of public connivance.

legal_principles.principle: The ends of justice should demand the transfer of the suit, appeal or other proceeding.
legal_principles.held: The cardinal principle for exercise of power under section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure is that the ends of justice should demand the transfer of the suit, appeal or other proceeding.
cited_cases: N.C.V. Aishwarya vs. A.S. Saravana Karthik, (2022) SCC Online SC 1199

legal_principles.principle: In matrimonial matters, the Courts have to take into consideration the economic soundness of both parties.
legal_principles.held: Courts have to take into consideration the economic soundness of both the parties, their standard of life prior to the marriage and subsequent thereto and the circumstances of both the parties in eking out their livelihood.
cited_cases: N.C.V. Aishwarya vs. A.S. Saravana Karthik, (2022) SCC Online SC 1199

legal_principles.principle: Generally, it is the wife's convenience which must be looked at while considering transfer.
legal_principles.held: Given the prevailing socio-economic paradigm in the Indian society, generally, it is the wife's convenience which must be looked at while considering transfer.
cited_cases: N.C.V. Aishwarya vs. A.S. Saravana Karthik, (2022) SCC Online SC 1199

outcome.final_order: The petition for transfer is allowed.

use_for_drafting: drafting a transfer petition in Family Court
